name: King County Treasury Operations
notes: Researched from public kingcounty.gov pages only. Online payment (payment.kingcounty.gov) by card, debit or eCheck: eCheck $0.55 flat, cards/PayPal 2.35% ($2.00 minimum), international cards 3.95% (minimums and international rate not expressible). Payments by mail (201 S. Jackson St., Suite 710, Seattle), in person (cash, check, card) and drop box; phone numbers are for customer service only, so pay_by_phone is unsupported (inferred). Deadlines April 30 and October 31 (second half 2026 due November 2). Payment plans are only for delinquent prior-year taxes, set up by email/phone with signed paper agreements and serviced by Evergreen Notes Servicing ($100 setup, $17/month); payment_arrangement is unsupported online with that note (the server drops the plan form). No automatic or monthly prepayment program is described. Interest/penalty rates were not stated on the pages read. Sign-in is synthetic. Review 2 (2026-10-09): the payment page (fees $0.55 eCheck, 2.35%/$2.00 minimum, 3.95% international, phone 206-263-2890) was re-checked; kingcounty.gov served an outage page during the review, so the payment-plan and property-tax pages could not be re-read and the builder's 2026-10-09 reading is kept. Contact set to 206-263-2890.

guest_pay.note: Pay online by credit card, debit card or electronic check; a service fee applies.

autopay.note: King County has no automatic payment program. Pay each half online, by mail, at the drop box or in person.

pay_by_phone.note: Payments are not taken by phone. Pay online, by mail, at the King Street Center drop box, or in person at 201 S. Jackson St.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check or money order to King County Treasury, 201 S. Jackson St., Suite 710, Seattle, WA 98104.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans cover delinquent prior-year taxes only and are set up by email or phone with signed paper agreements; Evergreen Notes Servicing collects the payments ($100 setup plus $17 a month). Call Property Tax Customer Service at 206-263-2890.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Pay online by credit card, debit card or electronic check; a service fee applies. By mail, send a check, cashier's check or money order (never cash) to King County Treasury, 201 S. Jackson St., Suite 710, Seattle, WA 98104, postmarked by the due date.

In person, the Customer Service Center on the second floor of 201 S. Jackson St. takes cash, check, money order or card on weekdays from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. A secure drop box inside King Street Center takes checks and money orders only during the same hours. Phone lines are for questions only: Property Tax Customer Service is 206-263-2890.

help.title: Online payment fees
paragraphs: An eCheck costs a flat $0.55. Credit cards, debit cards and PayPal cost 2.35% with a $2.00 minimum; international credit cards cost 3.95% with a $2.00 minimum. King County keeps none of these fees.

help.title: Due dates
paragraphs: Property taxes are due in two halves, by April 30 and October 31; for 2026 the second half is due November 2. Reminders go out about 30 days before each deadline, and fees are added to late payments.

help.title: Payment plans for delinquent taxes
paragraphs: Payment plans cover delinquent prior-year taxes only, for homes, commercial property, land and mobile homes, and cannot run past the date the property becomes subject to foreclosure. Owners with a mortgage must tell their lender.

To enroll, email or call the payment plans team with your contact details, tax account number, tax year and a 6- or 12-month term, then sign and return the plan agreement and the Evergreen Notes Servicing (ENS) contract. ENS collects the payments by the 5th of each month; payments sent to Treasury are rejected.
Plans cost a one-time $100 setup fee plus $17 a month, with monthly interest built in. Missing a payment cancels the plan.
